clauses.title: Docs page renders
clauses.rule: A migrated page exists at the bound path, default-exports, imports primitives from @/ds/core, and headless-renders with no thrown error / React console.error.

clauses.title: Section order
clauses.rule: SubHead meta order matches docs/ds-page-standard.json: Installation -> Usage -> Variants/Sizes/States -> [In context] -> Accessibility -> RTL -> Anatomy -> Do/Don't -> API reference.

clauses.title: Accessibility section
clauses.rule: Page has a SubHead meta="a11y" section mentioning keyboard + ARIA + contrast + reduced-motion.

clauses.title: RTL frame
clauses.rule: Page has a live Frame dir="rtl" with Arabic copy, or a matching waiver (foundations/CSS-only).

clauses.title: Visual anatomy
clauses.rule: Anatomy is rendered: .ana > .stage with numbered .pin + .lead connectors + numbered .ana-list legend (never a prose list).

clauses.title: Do/Don't grid
clauses.rule: Do/Don't uses .dd-grid.

clauses.title: Generated API table
clauses.rule: API reference uses <AutoPropsTable component="<export>"/>; no hand-authored table/PropsTable for a real export.

clauses.title: Header lede budget
clauses.rule: Header lede <=220 chars, plain text (no markup).

clauses.title: No per-page style
clauses.rule: No <style> block and no inline style={{ color|fontSize|padding|margin|background }} in migrated pages; compose .ds-* + var(--token).

clauses.title: Frame snippets parse
clauses.rule: Every Frame/CodeBlock/TabbedCode snippet TS-parses; a // @forge-frame:<storyId> Frame must equal its source story (no structural drift).

clauses.title: No AI slop
clauses.rule: No emoji feature-icons, no invented metrics, no filler copy, no placeholder CDNs, no hardcoded font-family outside var(--font-*).

clauses.title: Links resolve
clauses.rule: Every nav href resolves to a page/example; every page (except overview) is in nav; in-body anchors resolve.

clauses.title: Barrel export + parity
clauses.rule: Component is exported from packages/ui/src/index.ts barrel (resolved via surfaces.exportFile) and all four surfaces resolve.

clauses.title: Typecheck clean
clauses.rule: tsc --noEmit clean for @eidos/ui.

clauses.title: CSF3 story exists
clauses.rule: A CSF3 story exists; meta.title prefix is in preview.ts storySort.order AND matches its folder group; tags include 'autodocs'.

clauses.title: Variant/state matrix
clauses.rule: >=1 story per documented variant x state (incl. a States story); story renders in {dark,light} x {ltr,rtl} via the existing decorators.

clauses.title: Story a11y
clauses.rule: @storybook/addon-a11y / test-runner reports no critical/serious violations for the story.

clauses.title: Registry item valid
clauses.rule: A registry item exists; public/r/<name>.json builds; $schema valid; registryDependencies acyclic and present; files[].source resolve.

clauses.title: Registry source in sync
clauses.rule: Registry source (surfaces.registrySrc) matches its bound @eidos/ui source (surfaces.exportFile) — no drift. Bound via the explicit mapping, not a filename convention.

clauses.title: CLI install resolves deps
clauses.rule: eidos add <name> resolves the FULL transitive registryDependency graph and refuses to write if any dep is missing.

clauses.title: No visual drift
clauses.rule: No unexplained pixel drift vs tests/visual-baselines.

clauses.title: Contrast on fills
clauses.rule: Any foreground on an accent/elevated FILL is explicitly contrasting (dark ink on ember; light on dark; >=4.5:1 body / 3:1 UI). Token tertiary tiers (--fg-subtle/--fg-faint) remain advisory by design.

clauses.title: axe structural
clauses.rule: axe-core WCAG A/AA structural rules pass (color-contrast stays advisory per design decision).

clauses.title: DTCG tokens in sync
clauses.rule: tokens/forge.tokens.json is regenerated and in sync with the canonical packages/ui/styles/tokens.css (CSS is source; DTCG is export).

clauses.title: Contract valid
clauses.rule: eidos.contract.json validates against eidos.contract.schema.json; dsVersion == src/lib/site.ts DS_VERSION; every clause names a known verifier.
